concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-payment-method-node]] - Node.js payment-method webhook notification kinds and payload routes, with currently documented PayPal billing-agreement cancellation and Venmo revocation or enabled Enriched Customer Data update triggers
warnings: Preserve the page's currently qualification and do not generalize the notification kinds to every payment instrument or customer-data change.

Keep the two event subjects separate: revocation currently covers PayPal billing-agreement cancellation and named Venmo cases, while customer-data updates currently concern Venmo Enriched Customer Data and require merchant feature enablement.
